newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss KOF barometer rises 0.1 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Swiss KOF barometer rises 0.1 pct in March.

text.p: Switzerland's Centre for Research of Economic Activity (KOF) said its economic barometer rose a provisional 0.1 percent in March for a year-on-year rise of 0.8 percent.
In February the barometer also rose 0.1 percent for a year-on-year rise of 0.9 percent, KOF said in a statement.
"The prospects for a slight pickup in the economy from the second half of 1997 thus remain intact," said KOF, part of the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (ETH).
KOF noted that among its leading indicators real money supply again fell in March, while the manpower index of job vacancies showed a slight rise.
The other sub-indices -- construction, stocks in the machinery industry, employment prospects in industry -- were steady from the previous month.
